description: Universe of Tokyo Stock Exchange "yutai" (shareholder perk / 株主優待) issuers and their perk record-date month, used for the yutai calendar-effect research line. px.tar.gz (per-symbol daily price archive) is not itself covered by this schema -- see known_defects.
source: compiled list of TSE-listed issuers offering shareholder perks and their perk record-date month -- see backtest_data/yutai_<date>/manifest.md for compilation method and any known omissions.
retention: permanent dated snapshot (backtest_data/yutai_<date>/); never regenerated in place.

perk_flag.meaning: whether the issuer currently offers a shareholder perk

kenri_month.meaning: record-date (権利確定) month for the perk

known_defects: px.tar.gz (per-symbol daily price archive referenced by manifest.md) is a tar archive, not directly tabular, and is out of scope for this schema/data_quality.py's row-level checks -- see manifest.md for its own coverage notes

universe.csv is a point-in-time snapshot of perk-eligible issuers -- it is not forward-updated in place, and does not itself carry a fetch/effective date column (see the directory's own date suffix and manifest.md for that)
